Name: Ellie is moody. - a set of witchy farmer portraits
Author: tofuuHaus
Description:
[center][i][b]
[size=3]“React to NPCs’ mood in witchy style”
[/size][/b][/i]
[b]*Update V2.0*﻿
Edit Sad, Angry and Happy Art
(Add sad tears, angry magic aura and happy sunlight flare)[/b]



﻿Originally, I made these portraits for using in my gameplay.

The artwork is not mine. I only recolored the outfit and added few flowers to match my farmer's style.
The base art is from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1594940/Little_Witch_in_the_Woods/]Little Witch in the Woods[/url]﻿ by [url=https://x.com/SunnySideUp_Kor]Sunny Side up[/url]﻿. 

﻿

Also, I adapted the code of content.jason file from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20713?tab=files&file_id=85088](CP) Farmer portrait reactions template[/url]﻿ to my assets.
All credit should go to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mistyspring]mistyspring[/url]﻿. :)[/center]


[size=3][b]How to Install[/b]
1. Make sure you have the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20713]Farmer Portraits for 1.6[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
2. Download this mod and extract it to mods folder which is located in the game folder as same as other mods.
3. Launch the game via Stardew Modding API and config the setting as below.
